scenicChapters.title: Romania Maramures Wooden Churches Route
scenicChapters.narrative: Expect company on a summer weekend. Early is better than fast. For 31 km this is Romania Maramures Wooden Churches Route, a road with a name of its own and a reason for it.

places-chornohora-strimbu-baiut-2.story: From Kvasy it runs 178 km to Kvasy; allow about 3 h 04 of riding. It goes by way of Maramarosh, Wooden Churches of Maramureş, Strimbu Băiuț and back through Wooden Churches of Maramureş. The highest point is about 1,150 m. It crosses from Ukraine into Romania - carry ID and check vignette or toll rules. It was put together for the scenery rather than the shortest line.
